blockers.wanted: a knob that lengthens the heavy hit's ring (bodyenv.time) claiming decay
blockers.tried: claim decay on bodyenv.time; measured decay stays 0.95 s because sparse chips set the whole-sound -60 dB time
blockers.workaround: put the macro on shatter.spread (how long the chips keep falling)

blockers.wanted: a layer-level knob claiming lufs up
blockers.tried: debris gain claiming lufs; louder debris exceeded the hit's peak so the peak normalization turned everything down and lufs fell
blockers.workaround: claim crest -1 with a range that keeps the chips under the hit

blockers.where: listen centroid / bands on a sparse tail
blockers.wanted: a per-click table (time, level, centroid) for the chips to see thinning and spectrum of the chips alone
blockers.tried: listen node debris and onset list; the fine onsets list gives times only, the whole-sound centroid is dominated by the hit
blockers.workaround: read centroid by tenth and listen of the debris node

wishlist: a ready 'debris' / rockfall node (heavy hit plus thinning clicks) like shatter but with per-chip pitch tied to size
shatter option for a decaying (non-crowded-early only) spread so the cascade fills the requested spread
a per-layer or windowed decay measure for macro claims
what_worked: shatter into voices with a small stone modal per chip gave 20+ thinning clicks at once
modal size error text gave the exact usable size range and thickness, so I tuned pitch in one step
peak_db with fade_in 0.0005 delivered the hit at exactly -1.5 dBFS
